text:
sam: quick heads-up — during Zenith POC their React client sees intermittent streaming failures. SSE connections drop mid-stream and the client JSON parser gets 'Unexpected end of JSON input'. Happening ~10% of streams. any quick triage steps?
ana: can you paste the client logs + the raw server response for a failing request? also which EventSource polyfill/version are they on?
sam: using eventsource-polyfill v1.0, client logs show: 'EventSource connection closed', then 'SyntaxError: Unexpected end of JSON input at parse (<anonymous>)'. server side log snippet for req req-9a1b: "upstream write error: write EPIPE" then a 200 with partial chunk. curl repro we used: `curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACTED" -d '{"prompt":"hi"}' https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream` — outputs a few SSE chunks then connection closes.
eli: tagging in. two likely suspects: gateway/proxy buffering or upstream throttling (429). if the gateway returns 429 mid-stream it can truncate. can you check for any 429 in the request window? also share X-Request-Id from the client attempts.
sam: found 3 entries around the failures showing 429s: req-9a1b (429), req-9a2c (200 partial), req-9a3d (connection reset). customer says non-stream (stream=false) succeeds every time.
eli: that matches throttling/backpressure. will tail gateway logs and check keepalive/proxy buffer settings. quick workaround: have client enable auto-reconnect + rehydrate partial state on reconnect (seq ids). good long-term fix is to ensure gateway flushes complete JSON objects (or SSE "data: [chunk]

") and doesn't close mid-frame.
deploy-bot: deploy at 2026-03-19T15:02:11Z — rolled gateway patch v1.2.8 (gateway: flush-on-chunk, better EPIPE handling)
nana: after the patch can you run the curl repro and attach raw output (no browser polyfills) and the plain tcp dump if possible? also try adding `?stream=false` to confirm fallback.
sam: customer ran curl again after patch — streams are more stable but still one case where client saw truncated JSON. attached raw output: `data: {"id":"abc","choices":[{"delta":{"content":"Hel` then connection closed.
eli: ok seeing EPIPE in logs for the same timestamp. hypothesis: upstream worker hitting max inflight token limit and forcibly closing connection. will open a short-lived bypass that buffers per-connection and ensures we only close after completing a full SSE event. will also increase per-POC inflight limit.
nana: noted on presales side — asking finance to hold off on Dedicated commitment until we confirm stability. please log impact and ETA.
sam: customer available for screenshare tomorrow 10am PT for live repro. thanks everyone, will update once Eli confirms bypass rollout. :pray:
eli: i'll post follow-ups here after bypass is up. short-term mitigation: client retry with exponential backoff and tolerate partial events (reconstruct by sequence id). long-term: patch gateway + adjust throttling thresholds. :thumbsup:
